description: Run a Salesforce sync for your workspace now. direction pull reads Salesforce Accounts, Contacts and Opportunities into Last Price customers and contacts (matched by email domain or email first, created only when nothing matches); push sends each order of a linked customer to Salesforce as an Opportunity whose amount is the order total; both (the default) does both. Idempotent: a second run creates nothing new. Returns the sync log row with counts. Salesforce must be connected first, by a person in the dashboard (Settings, Integrations). Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:write scope, and Salesforce offered to the workspace (404 otherwise; list_integrations says). Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: sync_salesforce
